facts.text: Andrew participated in a rock climbing class and reached the top, feeling accomplished and proud of himself.

evidence.quote: Rock climbing was awesome! It was a challenge, but so satisfying. The view was stunning, and I was really proud of myself.
It was a big achievement for me. The climb was tricky, especially since I'm still a newbie. But I made it with the support and cheer from my friends.

facts.text: Andrew shared a photo of the view from the top of the rock climb during the class.

evidence.quote: [Shares a photo of the view from the top of the rock climbed during the rock climbing class]

facts.text: Andrew mentioned that the rock climbing experience encouraged him to try more outdoor activities, including kayaking and bungee jumping.

evidence.quote: It has definitely encouraged me to try more outdoor activities like kayaking and maybe bungee jumping? Nature always pushes me out of my comfort zone!

facts.text: Audrey expressed admiration for Andrew's accomplishment and asked if the experience encouraged him to try more outdoor activities.

evidence.quote: Does this adventure encourage you to try more outdoor activities?
